Native observation sequence numbers and correlated request/event IDs are retained. Bucket/account/IAM ARN are normalized; public synthetic customer key and payload remain the captured values.

Only selected request-correlated data records are asserted. Setup and state transitions have no delivery expectation. Bounded undelivered calls, including the HTTP failure, establish no absence or non-emission assertion.

Request/response maps are matched exactly: all selected data records omit customer key and key-MD5; customer algorithm remains present, successful customer Put reports SSE_C, and customer Get has null responseElements and no SSEApplied.

Malformed MD5 under explicit policy deny and missing customer key under bucket blocking retain InvalidArgument. Valid policy-denied writes retain objectSize; blocked writes and malformed customer headers omit it.

SDK-origin policy writes retain the existing ${bodyMD5} request normalization. HTTP byte counts and transport correlation use replay responses; service-generated timestamps, request IDs, extended IDs and network identity are not pinned to AWS constants.
